protocol:
1. Arrange the bench with gloved hands, single-channel micropipettes, a multichannel pipette, sterile tip boxes, a purple microcentrifuge-tube rack, a yellow 96-well plate/rack, labeled microcentrifuge tubes, and a labeled Petri dish.

2. Open the sterile tip boxes and position the blue, pink, and yellow tip racks within reach beside the tube rack and 96-well plate/rack.

3. Select a single-channel adjustable micropipette and set the volume using the volume dial.

4. Attach a sterile pipette tip to the single-channel micropipette from an open tip box.

5. Open a labeled microcentrifuge tube held in the purple rack and pipette liquid into the tube with the single-channel micropipette.

6. Mix the liquid in the open microcentrifuge tube by aspirating and dispensing with the pipette tip.

7. Close the microcentrifuge tube and return it to the purple tube rack.

8. Repeat the pipetting and mixing process with additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes in the purple rack, changing pipette tips between transfers.

9. Adjust another single-channel micropipette and attach a fresh sterile tip.

10. Transfer liquid between labeled microcentrifuge tubes and wells in the yellow 96-well plate/rack using the single-channel micropipette.

11. Hold the labeled Petri dish open and dispense liquid onto the agar surface with the pipette tip.

12. Spread or streak the dispensed liquid across the agar surface by dragging the pipette tip along the plate.

13. Set the Petri dish back on the bench after spotting or streaking the sample.

14. Repeat the agar spotting or streaking step with additional liquid samples from microcentrifuge tubes.

15. Pipette additional liquid into selected wells of the yellow 96-well plate/rack using a single-channel micropipette and fresh tips.

16. Attach multiple tips to a multichannel pipette from the yellow 96-well tip rack.

17. Use the multichannel pipette to dispense liquid into a row of wells in the yellow 96-well plate/rack.

18. Remove the multichannel pipette from the plate/rack and place it back on the bench.

19. Pick up and reposition individual small tubes or tube strips in the yellow 96-well plate/rack.

20. Leave the labeled microcentrifuge tubes in the purple rack, the processed Petri dish on the bench, and the pipettes and tip boxes arranged around the work area.
